correctness.rationale: Wang's full paper confirms the same operator/class and upper constant two. The four-vertex core has a fixed-rank normalized-Laplacian limit with nonzero spectrum bounded from zero, so its generalized inverse square root converges. The exact two-by-two block calculation gives the limiting edge values and weak ratio \(2/\sqrt3\). The infinite level lift rescales the core Laplacian by \((1+\tau)^{-1}\), kills vertical gradients on level-constant inputs, and loses only \((1+\tau)^{-1/2}\). Independent numerical reconstruction corroborated the finite-core limit.
